one_liner_zh: 林德公布最新季度財報，每股盈餘略微優於市場預期，營收持續展現穩健成長動能。
one_liner_en: Linde reported its latest quarterly earnings with EPS slightly beating estimates and continued steady revenue growth.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：每股盈餘 4.50 美元，優於市場預期的 4.49 美元。
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘達 4.50 美元，實現 0.31% 的正驚喜。
季度營收達到 92.9 億美元，年增率達 9.35%。
本益比維持在 30.09 倍，反映市場對其高品質成長的溢價評價。
highlights_en: EPS reached $4.50, achieving a 0.31% positive surprise against estimates.
Quarterly revenue hit $9.29B, representing a year-over-year growth of 9.35%.
Trailing PE ratio stands at 30.09, reflecting market premium for its high-quality growth.
risks_zh: 全球工業氣體需求可能受製造業景氣放緩影響。
高本益比面臨潛在的評價修正壓力。
risks_en: Global industrial gas demand may be affected by a slowdown in manufacturing activity.
High valuation multiples face potential multiple contraction pressure.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：財報表現穩健符合防禦型成長定位，訊號中性偏多。短中期有助於支撐股價抗跌，但高評價水準限制了大幅上行空間。未來應追蹤全球工業生產指數、資本支出執行進度及訂單積壓狀況。
ai_view_en: View: Solid results reinforce defensive growth positioning, signaling neutral-to-positive momentum. Near-to-mid term implication supports price resilience, though high valuation limits aggressive upside. Track global industrial production index, capital expenditure execution, and order backlog.
